title: Spend Less, Fit Better: Budget-Efficient Scaling Law Fitting via Active Experiment Selection
abstract: arXiv:2604.22753v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scaling laws are used to plan multi-million-dollar training runs, but fitting those laws can itself cost millions. In modern large-scale workflows, assembling a sufficiently informative set of pilot experiments is already a major budget-allocation problem rather than a routine preprocessing step. We formulate scaling-law fitting as budget-aware sequential experimental design: given a finite pool of runnable experiments with heterogeneous costs, choose which runs to execute so as to maximize extrapolation accuracy in a high-cost target region. We propose $\mathrm{SL}^2$ (Scaling Laws, Spend Less), an uncertainty-aware method for sequentially allocating experimental budget toward the runs most useful for target-region extrapolation. translated_title: 少花钱，更拟合：通过主动实验选择实现预算高效的缩放定律拟合
translated_abstract: 缩放定律被用于规划耗资数百万美元的训练运行，但拟合这些定律本身可能就要花费数百万。在现代大规模工作流程中，组装一组信息量充足的试点实验已经成为一个主要的预算分配问题，而非常规预处理步骤。我们将缩放定律拟合视为预算感知的序贯实验设计：给定一个具有异质成本的有限可运行实验池，选择执行哪些运行，以最大化高成本目标区域中的外推精度。我们提出了$\mathrm{SL}^2$（缩放定律，少花钱），这是一种不确定性感知的方法，用于序贯分配实验预算，以优先选择对目标区域外推最有用的运行。在多样化的缩放定律任务基准上，$\mathrm{SL}^2$优于基于经典设计的基线方法，并且常常在仅使用部分实验集时接近在全实验集上拟合的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种预算高效的主动实验选择方法$\mathrm{SL}^2$，通过序贯分配实验预算，在不牺牲外推精度的前提下显著降低缩放定律拟合成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a budget-efficient active experiment selection method, $\mathrm{SL}^2$, which sequentially allocates experimental budget to reduce scaling-law fitting costs without sacrificing extrapolation accuracy.
